workflows.templates.text2image.desc: The basic shape: one picture from a model and a prompt, saved.
workflows.templates.text2imageUpscale.de: Makes a 1024 picture and saves it enlarged to 2048.
workflows.templates.loraStack.title: Stack two LoRAs
workflows.templates.loraStack.desc: Chains LoRAs onto the model for style and detail.
workflows.templates.image2image.title: Image to image
workflows.templates.image2image.desc: Redraws a picture you have with a new prompt. Denoising start sets how much of the original stays.
workflows.templates.upscale.title: Upscale
workflows.templates.upscale.desc: Enlarges a picture with an upscaling model.
workflows.templates.controlnetCanny.desc: Extracts the edges of a picture and draws something new in the same shape.
workflows.templates.imageToVideo.title: Image to video
workflows.templates.imageToVideo.desc: Animates one picture into a short clip.

workflows.packs.catalog.nkd: Face Rig (expression, gaze and head turn), film grain, color, masks, crop and merge.
workflows.packs.catalog.impact: FaceDetailer, which finds faces and redraws them, plus detail fixes and segmentation.
workflows.packs.catalog.impactSubpack: Loads the face and hand detectors the Impact Pack uses.
workflows.packs.catalog.rmbg: Removes the background and keeps only people or objects.
workflows.packs.catalog.cropStitch: Crops a part, redraws it and stitches it back into the picture.
workflows.packs.catalog.ultimateUpscale: Enlarges a picture in tiles, redrawing each for fine detail.
workflows.packs.catalog.controlnetAux: ControlNet preprocessors (depth, pose, line art and more).
workflows.packs.catalog.frameInterpolati: Adds frames between frames for smoother video.
workflows.packs.catalog.layerStyle: Layer blending, shadows, strokes and color adjustment.
workflows.packs.catalog.gguf: Loads GGUF models so they run in less memory.
workflows.packs.catalog.ipadapter: Carries the style or face of a reference picture into the generation.
workflows.templates.filmGrain.title: Finish with film grain
workflows.templates.filmGrain.desc: Adds photographic grain to the generated picture and saves it.
workflows.templates.faceRig.title: Move the expression and gaze
workflows.templates.faceRig.desc: Changes the expression, gaze and head turn of a portrait. Open "Adjust expression and gaze" on the node and drag the handles on the face.
workflows.templates.tiledUpscale.title: Tiled detailed upscale
workflows.templates.tiledUpscale.desc: Enlarges a picture to 2048 and redraws it tile by tile to add detail.
workflows.templates.styleReference.title: Draw in a reference's style
workflows.templates.styleReference.desc: Carries the style of a reference picture into the prompt's picture. ComfyUI needs the IP-Adapter models.
workflows.packs.whatToDo: Find by what you want to do
workflows.packs.askMessage: What extensions are there? I'd like the ones you recommend for a beginner.
workflows.packs.goal.face.title: Fix faces
workflows.packs.goal.face.desc: Redraw broken faces automatically. Change expression and gaze too.
workflows.packs.goal.background.title: Remove a background
workflows.packs.goal.background.desc: Cut out people or objects, or just the thing you click.
workflows.packs.goal.partial.title: Redraw just one part
workflows.packs.goal.partial.desc: Mark only what to fix and blend it back in naturally.
workflows.packs.goal.upscale.title: Make it bigger and sharper
workflows.packs.goal.upscale.desc: Enlarge a small picture without losing fine detail.
workflows.packs.goal.pose.title: Draw from a pose or line art
workflows.packs.goal.pose.desc: Carry the pose, depth or line art of a picture into a new one.
workflows.packs.goal.style.title: Match a reference's style or person
workflows.packs.goal.style.desc: Take the style or face from a single reference picture.
workflows.packs.goal.video.title: Make or smooth a video
workflows.packs.goal.video.desc: Generate video, add in-between frames, load and save clips.
workflows.packs.goal.color.title: Polish color and texture
workflows.packs.goal.color.desc: Film grain, color grading, shadows and strokes, extra detail.
workflows.packs.goal.caption.title: Turn a picture into words
workflows.packs.goal.caption.desc: Get a description or tags from a picture to use as a prompt.
workflows.packs.goal.light.title: Run on less memory
workflows.packs.goal.light.desc: Make heavy models light enough for the GPU you have: quantised files, 4-bit, and making video a section at a time.
workflows.packs.goal.handy.title: Handy toolboxes
workflows.packs.goal.handy.desc: Resize, masks, maths and other small everyday tools.
workflows.packs.catalog.sam2: Turns the object you click or box into an exact mask. Works on video too.
workflows.packs.catalog.inpaintNodes: Fills the area to redraw before sampling, so seams are less likely.
workflows.packs.catalog.seedvr2: Restores and enlarges old photos or rough video in one step.
workflows.packs.catalog.pulid: Keeps a person's likeness from one photo while the rest follows the prompt.
workflows.packs.catalog.wanVideo: Finer control of Wan video models (camera, reference, long clips, low memory).
workflows.packs.catalog.videoHelper: Loads video files as frames and saves frames as MP4 or GIF.
workflows.packs.catalog.animatediff: Adds motion to image models to make short animations.
workflows.packs.catalog.detailDaemon: Adds fine detail and texture while sampling so flat pictures get crisp.
workflows.packs.catalog.florence2: Describes a picture in words. Finds things by name and makes masks.
workflows.packs.catalog.wd14: Pulls the tags out of an anime-style picture.
workflows.packs.catalog.kjnodes: A big set of small helpers: masks, batching, resizing, color matching.
workflows.packs.catalog.essentials: Everyday nodes the core lacks: resize, crop, mask tools, maths.
workflows.packs.catalog.was: A large suite of image filters, blends, text and number tools, lists.
workflows.templates.faceDetailer.title: Find and redraw faces
workflows.templates.faceDetailer.desc: Finds the faces in the generated picture, redraws them at high resolution and puts them back. Small broken faces get clean.
workflows.templates.removeBackground.des: Keeps only the person or object and makes the background transparent. The model is fetched on first use.
workflows.templates.poseControl.title: Draw from a pose
workflows.templates.poseControl.desc: Extracts the pose of the person in a reference and draws a new picture in the same stance. Needs an OpenPose ControlNet model.
workflows.templates.captionToImage.title: Describe a picture, then redraw it
workflows.templates.captionToImage.desc: Turns a reference picture into a description and uses it as the prompt for a new picture.
workflows.templates.whiteBackground.desc: Keeps only the person or object and turns the background plain white. A good preparation for a reference picture, so its background color does not spread into the result.
workflows.templates.characterReference.d: Puts the character's picture on a white background, uses it as a reference and draws a new scene with the same hair, eyes and clothes. The CFG scale is set low, as references need.
workflows.templates.characterPose.title: Draw the same character in a chosen pose
workflows.templates.characterPose.desc: Takes the character's look from a reference picture and the posture from a stick figure (OpenPose). Needs an OpenPose ControlNet model.
workflows.faceRig.title: Adjust expression and gaze
workflows.faceRig.needsImage: Connect an Image node to open it
workflows.faceRig.hint: Drag the circles on the face. The discs set the gaze and the head turn (double-click to reset).
workflows.faceRig.head: Head turn
workflows.faceRig.noFace: No face was found. A picture with a larger face works better.
workflows.faceRig.notAccepted: The picture was not accepted. Try restarting ComfyUI.
workflows.faceRig.anim.title: Animate to a GIF or a video
workflows.faceRig.anim.hint: Set an expression and press "Add this expression", then add another one. With two or more, a GIF (or a video) is made that moves smoothly between them.
workflows.faceRig.anim.loop: Also return from the last to the first

workflows.packs.catalog.framePack: Makes a long video from one image a little at a time; works on a GPU with about 6 GB.

workflows.templates.videoWan22.title: Video (Wan 2.2 5B, from text)
workflows.templates.videoWan22.desc: Makes a video with ComfyUI's own nodes, on the models of the Video tab. Length, size and sampler are yours to change.
workflows.templates.videoWan22Image.desc: Animates the picture you pick, built from ComfyUI's own nodes, so frames and sampler are yours to change.
workflows.templates.musicAceStep.title: Music (ACE-Step 1.5)
workflows.templates.musicAceStep.desc: Makes a song from style tags and lyrics, with ComfyUI's own nodes and the model of the Music tab.
workflows.nodes.voice_speak.title: Read Aloud
workflows.nodes.voice_speak.desc: Makes a sound of the text read aloud (Qwen3-TTS). Connect it to a node that takes sound, for example Save Audio to keep it as an MP3, or a video's sound.
workflows.fields.speaker: Speaker
workflows.readiness.voicePack: The voice engine and models are not installed yet. Install them on the Voice tab
workflows.templates.voiceRead.title: Voice (read aloud to MP3)
workflows.templates.voiceRead.desc: Reads a text aloud and saves the sound as an MP3, with the engine of the Voice tab.
workflows.templates.videoNarration.title: Add narration to a video
workflows.templates.videoNarration.desc: Takes a video from the gallery, puts a text read aloud on it as its sound, and saves it as a new video.
workflows.nodeLibrary.hint: Double-click to add to the middle, or drag onto the canvas to place it anywhere.
workflows.packs.catalog.mangascreen: Finishes a picture as a black-and-white manga page: lines, flat tones and real screentone.
